items.item_text: Current and valid California Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS) license.
Two years of recent experience performing testing in a high volume laboratory, preferred.

Join our team as a Per Diem Clinical Laboratory Scientist, where you'll contribute to high-quality laboratory services in Anesthesiology and Core Laboratory. In this role, you’ll handle specimen processing, method development, testing across multiple areas, instrument maintenance, quality control, and data entry.
Note: This position primarily covers the night shift, though additional shift coverage may be required based on operational needs.
Recent demonstrated technical competence in high volume chemistry/hematology.
Must pass the Ishihara Color Vision exam, i.e. visual acuity including color differentiation.

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
Availability to work weekends and holidays.
